Detects Vue SPA shell with empty #app div as needing JS rendering

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'browser' => { 'mode' => 'never' } }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.js_render_hint.inspect
puts result.browser_used.inspect
```
